Batch 3 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 3 resolves 24 longstanding mystery recordings across two iconic dramatic canons: Orson Welles' legendary London production of The Black Museum (Scotland Yard's repository of murder relics, Towers of London / Mutual 1952 syndication) and Bartlett Robinson / John Larkin's 1949 CBS daytime courtroom run of Perry Mason.

1. The Black Museum (Host: Orson Welles) — 1952 Mutual / Towers Discs Dated

Every episode of The Black Museum is built around a physical homicide exhibit from Scotland Yard. ASR transcription of Orson Welles' introductory monologues directly maps each tape to the 1952 master broadcast register:
